Every business starts at Assist. You promote the AI one action type at a time, based on measured accuracy, not promises.

  1. 1

    Assist

    AI drafts, humans send. Every action waits in the approval queue. This is day one, and some businesses happily stay here.

  2. 2

    Approve

    Routine, low-risk actions run with one-tap approval; anything sensitive still waits. You see a log of everything.

  3. 3

    Autopilot

    Action types with proven accuracy run within hard caps, and demote themselves automatically if anything drifts.

QUESTIONS OWNERS ASK

Answers, not reassurance.

Will AI replace my sales team?

No. The AI workforce does the remembering and the follow-up your team never has time for; your people do the selling.

What if the AI drafts something wrong?

Nothing goes out without approval until you decide otherwise. You can edit any draft, reject it, or switch a whole action type off.

Can I turn it all off?

Yes, instantly, at five levels: one action, one agent, one branch, one channel, or everything.

Can the AI give a discount without my knowledge?

No, pricing and discounts follow your price rules and staff permissions; the AI drafts messages, it does not set prices.

What if it embarrasses me with a longtime customer?

The approval queue exists for exactly this. Nothing reaches her until your team has seen and approved it.

Does the AI voice agent that calls customers speak all 14 languages too?

Not yet, and we’d rather say so than blur it: the chat/voice assistant above speaks 14 languages; the separate outbound/inbound phone-calling agent (running over a connected telephony line, Exotel, Tata Tele, or another provider) currently covers 11 Indian languages.
